working_definition: Author type 'G03' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: A supporting cell of the nervous system.

justification: A glial identity the authors left numbered (G03); class glia. FBbt has no immature or pupal optic lobe glia term; the stage-neutral glial cell is used (as for Kurmangaliyev 2020 early glia).
